Name: Flags of the World
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[size=6][b][u]Flags of the World
[/u][/b][/size][size=3]
Adds flags of the world to the Furniture Catalogue.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/e6ZHscA.png[/img]﻿[/center][size=5][u][b]Installation[/b]
[/u][size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI
﻿[/url]-  and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
Drop the mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder, load up the game. Enjoy :)

[/size][/size][/size][size=5][b][u]Extra
[/u][/b][/size][size=3]Some indices have conflicts with Custom Furniture. I tried testing them all, but I might have missed some. So if your beloved flag turns into a random object, let me know and I'll fix it.
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/OPFNHyi.png[/img][/center][/size]
